about.title: About Dr. Rayess
about.subtitle: A Pioneer in Osteopathic Medicine
about.bio: Dr. Adel Rayess is a Doctor of Osteopathy with a PhD from the University of Lugano, Switzerland. With over 20 years of clinical experience, he developed The Primary Lesion methodology and the trademarked Rayess-Schoening Technique.
about.credential1: PhD in Osteopathic Medicine - University of Lugano, Switzerland
about.credential2: Active Member - International Scientific Society of Osteopathic Medicine, Geneva
about.credential3: International Lecturer - IGMEDT Vienna, NeuroSpine Seminars
about.methodologyDesc: A proprietary diagnostic and treatment approach that identifies the primary biomechanical dysfunction responsible for a patient's symptoms, enabling targeted and effective treatment.
